org.trupp_global

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained root, dated annotation article, March2026VAPT article and websiteprivacy texts were actually read in this new metadata phase. They support one commercial operating brand offering dedicated outsourced teams and, explicitly, text-labeling/data-annotation services for AI customers. The requested annotation-service URL resolves to a2024explanatoryarticle with an explicit Trupp text-labeling offer; its general audio/image/video definitions are not treated as proof of separate delivered modalities. The public websiteprivacy names Trupp Global Technologies Pvt Ltd as websiteowner/controller; independent registration, contracting authority and parent ownership remain unverified. This scoped available-primary capability/process/limits audit supports supplier classification conditional on independent commercial/group metadata review and import of the exact four already-three-role-passed own-subject facts. It does not independently establish named customer-specific AI-data delivery, recruitment credentials, annotation-specific adjudication/QA performance, staff/active-worker totals, revenue or full output/IP rights. The VAPT statement is a self-reported third-party internal-network assessment, not a blanket annotation/customer-corpus security certification; the privacy statement is for website data, not all client corpora. No scientific wording or review digest changes, no service-quality endorsement and no catalog/research-function closure follow.
